question: Which packets and multiplicities belong to ordinary Edgar Skill/Burst casts?
stop_condition: Identify packets/multiplicities from saved descriptions and native arrays; use a disclosed bounded timing hypothesis if intervals are absent.
return_condition: New timing/reachability evidence changes Wild Current 7x Skill_Damage or Finnegan's Wake 1x UltraSkill_Damage, channeling ticks, or healing callbacks.
decision: Wild Current describes 7 instances totaling 80%*7 at Lv1, matching native GE_Player_Edgar_Skill_Damage (7 hits). Finnegan's Wake describes 1 instance totaling 400% at Lv1, matching native GE_Player_Edgar_UltraSkill_Damage (1 hit). Require each action's primary packet; schedule children once after admission with the admitted effective native coordinate. Each hit settles independently; successful admitted own Skill/QTE grants one Key of Truth up to three, A1+ observes teammate QTE, and Ultimate samples keys for 10s + 1s each at every awakening. The prior A1 +5% per-key damage claim is superseded by reviews/q2-edgar-periodic-healing.json; A4 Skill DMG (+50%) and other separately scoped awakening hooks remain.
timing_hypothesis: edgar.skill_burst_packets_v1: ordered coincident delivery on target zero at selected primary impact time. This supports packet totals and ownership, not native frame timing. Same-time delivery precedes queued gear callbacks; timing-sensitive results retain this assumption.
checks: Independent content damage oracles: at 1000 ATK/DEF.5/RES0, Skill levels 1/8/effective9 total 2800/1, 9597/2, 10367/2 (A3 resonance), 31101/4 (A3 resonance + A4 +50% DMG); Burst levels 1/8/effective9 total 2000/1, 6855/2, 3702/1 (A3 resonance).
Pending horizons, off-field ownership, dead/lethal targets, rejected energy admission and alternate primary are checked. Strict requires matching hypothesis acceptance.

Description and native arrays agree at all nine levels. Public two-Skill/one-Burst rotation produces 15 hits and spends 100 energy once; CLI/WASM/Worker agree. Full content, relevant character/gear web suites, replay and modeled awakening verifier pass.
No full kit/readiness claim. Normal chains, continuous channeling intervals, teammate lowest-HP healing, and complete kit interactions remain pending.
